name: ea_ps2342_bridge
description: EA-PS2342-06B dual-channel 42V/6A power supply via TCP bridge. Requires ea_bridge.py running on localhost:5025.
author: Community

eez-studio.moreDescription:
EA-PS2342-06B power supply (binary serial protocol) via TCP bridge.

SETUP:
1. pip install pyserial
2. python ea_bridge.py --serial COM3 --tcp-port 5025
3. In EEZ Studio: add Ethernet instrument → localhost:5025

TOOLBAR:
- Configure: set V/I/output/OVP/OCP for both channels via dialog
- Live: continuous V/I readout, stop with the Stop button
- Output: quick on/off control for each channel
- Logger: start/stop CSV logging with configurable interval and duration

BRIDGE COMMANDS (usable in EEZ terminal):
*IDN?  VOLT 1,12.5  CURR 1,2.0  OUTP 1,ON
MEAS:ALL? 1  SETP? 2  LOG:START file.csv,0.5,,1,2  LOG:STOP

NOTE: CH3 (5V fixed) is not remotely controllable per device spec.
